title: Tree in the backyard bursts into flame
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Tree in the backyard bursts into flame, about after the Zanesville trip at His backyard, North Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, we had this tree that just spontaneously combusted in the backyard. It rained for two days.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says strange things happen around him, says that after a trip to Zanesville a tree in his backyard just burst into flames by itself. He adds that it had rained for two days before. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast as one of the odd events in his life that he can't explain.
